description: Hybrid base fallback and smooth regrasp; targeted wins did not survive full 50-seed run.

description: Use fixed-arm screw L-transport with 5 cm detour; 20-worker remote run improved 47→48/50 and removed transport reversal failure.

asi.result: 48/50; seed46 transport recovered locally and remote failures reduced to one abort plus one terminal metric failure.
asi.next_action_hint: Analyze two remaining seeds; likely regrasp relocation and final settling.

description: Elevated above-tray regrasp fallback did not improve 48/50 in full 20-worker run; aggregate unchanged.

description: Use fixed-arm screw for Stage 1/2 and preserve mild bent carry pose; 20-worker remote run improved 48→49/50.

asi.hypothesis: Noisy initial base staging was still moving the bent arm/cup off the ideal pre-grasp corridor; fixed-arm screw geometry should keep live TCP offset stable before grasp.

asi.next_action_hint: Inspect final failed seed and make one targeted correction; avoid broad strategy changes.

description: Raise torso to transport height after Stage 8 lift-test before Stage 10 return; 20-worker remote run reached 50/50.

description: Repeated final 20-worker benchmark; 50/50 confirmed again.

name: TakeItBack planner runtime with 100-seed safety gate

description: New runtime baseline from existing full 100-seed run: 100/100; median planner time 287.463 s, median pre-grasp time 128.717 s.

asi.hypothesis: Use per-seed event timestamps as runtime metric, with success_count=100 as hard safety gate; remote batch wall time remains a noisy secondary.
asi.result: Baseline established from 100 completed seeds. Stage 0 accounts for most pre-grasp steps; measure now reports planner and pre-grasp medians.
asi.next_action_hint: Shorten Stage 0 torso/pan/arm ramps together conservatively, then require 100/100 and lower median runtime.

description: Candidate benchmark did not start: remote SSH connection closed before run directory creation; no seeds produced.

asi.hypothesis: Conservative pre-grasp ramp reductions (torso 150→100, pan 250→150, arm 120→80, grasp torso 120→80) were ready for validation.
asi.rollback_reason: Infrastructure failure, not planner result; remote benchmark produced zero logs.
asi.next_action_hint: Analyze existing 100-seed event logs for idle/compute-heavy stages while remote access recovers; rerun candidate later.

description: Shortened Stage 0/2 ramps and arm pan ramp; pre-grasp median fell 128.72→96.14 s, but planner median worsened 287.46→298.92 s and reliability fell to 98/100.

asi.hypothesis: Reducing torso 150→100, pan 250→150, arm bend 120→80, and pre-grasp torso 120→80 would remove idle-looking ramp time without changing geometry.
asi.result: Pre-grasp was 25% faster, but two failures and slower total runtime show ramps provide needed settling/trajectory stability; candidate over-aggressive or changes interact with later stages.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed and success gate missed 100/100; automatic discard restored baseline planner.
asi.next_action_hint: Measure stage-3 planner waits and isolate one reduction at a time; do not repeat combined ramp cut.

description: Shortened only Stage 0 torso/pan/arm ramps; pre-grasp improved 128.72→121.10 s, but total median worsened 287.46→320.55 s and result fell to 98/100.

asi.hypothesis: Stage 0 is slowest pre-grasp block; reducing torso 150→100, pan 250→150, arm bend 120→80 while keeping Stage 2 torso ramp should preserve downstream stability.
asi.result: Still regressed despite retaining Stage 2. Faster Stage 0 causes later trajectory/refinement cost or failures; fixed ramp shortening is not a safe speed win.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed and 100/100 safety gate failed; automatic discard restored baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not shorten physical ramps further. Target actual no-motion loops: Stage 3 refinement and release settling, with explicit path/velocity guards.

description: Skipped refinement in Stage 3 screw reaches; 100/100 preserved but median planner time 287.46→288.48 s and pre-grasp time slightly worsened.

asi.hypothesis: Stage 3 `Robot is stuck` comes from refinement-only idle steps; direct masked screw execution should remove them without changing path.
asi.result: No speed gain; direct execution was 1.02 s slower within noise. Reliability stayed 100/100.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime unchanged/slightly worse; automatic discard restored baseline.
asi.next_action_hint: Use requested 10-worker benchmark for runtime comparison; keep Stage 3 baseline and focus on measured no-motion outliers only.

name: TakeItBack planner runtime with 50-seed safety gate at 10 workers

description: 50-seed, 10-worker baseline: 50/50; median planner time 119.677 s and median pre-grasp time 53.525 s.

asi.hypothesis: Rebaseline requested 50-seed benchmark at 10 workers before speed changes; success remains hard gate.
asi.result: Current planner reproduced 50/50. Stage 0 remains dominant pre-grasp block; no-motion Stage 3 is smaller, while release settling only becomes pathological after unstable motion.
asi.next_action_hint: Use 10-worker runs for fair comparison; test no-motion optimization only if it lowers runtime without changing physical ramps.

description: Shortened only initial torso ramp 150→100; 50/50 preserved, but median planner time worsened 119.68→147.69 s and pre-grasp time increased.

asi.hypothesis: Initial torso ramp alone was unnecessary overhead; removing 50 steps should reduce pre-grasp latency while leaving pan/arm settling intact.
asi.result: No speed win; slower downstream execution despite 50/50. The longer baseline ramp likely stabilizes torso/arm before planning and transport.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed by 23.4%; automatic discard restored 150-step ramp.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not shorten physical ramps. Optimize only true idle waits, starting with robust release settle handling or eliminate redundant planner calls.

description: Disabled solver verbose logging; 50/50 and runtime improved, but user requires geometry-only optimization, so change intentionally discarded.

asi.hypothesis: Per-step verbose action logging was runtime overhead, not planner geometry.
asi.result: Median planner time improved 119.68→98.44 s and pre-grasp 53.53→46.85 s, confirming logging cost.
asi.rollback_reason: Explicit user constraint: do not optimize by disabling verbose; keep diagnostics output unchanged.
asi.next_action_hint: Optimize geometric path/phase strategy only; preserve verbose=True.

description: Combined high-torso pan+bend into one 180-step arm path; 50/50, planner median 119.68→103.26 s, pre-grasp 53.53→38.72 s.

asi.hypothesis: Sequential pan ramp (250) then elbow bend (120) repeats same high-clearance corridor. One joint-space path to identical bent pose should preserve geometry while removing 190 simulation steps.
asi.result: 50/50 preserved. Median pre-grasp improved 27.7%; total planner improved 13.7%; batch wall 863.7→672.6 s. Geometry-only speedup validated.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep combined path. Repeat 50/10 for noise confirmation before any further geometry change; do not disable verbose or alter evaluation.

description: Repeat combined pan+bend geometry: 50/50 confirmed; planner median 103.26→101.07 s, pre-grasp 38.72→37.90 s.

asi.hypothesis: Previous geometry speedup should reproduce at requested 10-worker concurrency.
asi.result: Second independent 50/10 run also 50/50. Median planner 101.07 s; pre-grasp 37.90 s; batch wall 665.5 s. Improvement is repeatable.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep combined 180-step arm path. Test only one further structural reduction if it preserves 50/50; otherwise finish with repeated confirmation.

description: Shortened combined pan+bend arm path 180→160 steps; 49/50 and median planner 115.59 s, worse than validated 180-step path.

asi.hypothesis: The combined high-torso path has enough clearance margin to run 20 steps faster.
asi.result: One abort and slower runtime; 160 steps is beyond reliable geometry margin.
asi.rollback_reason: Missed 50/50 safety gate and primary runtime regressed; automatic discard restored 180 steps.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep 180-step combined path as speed/reliability frontier; no more aggressive arm ramp cuts.

description: Tested 170-step combined pan+bend geometry; 49/50, so no improvement over validated 180-step path.

asi.hypothesis: A 10-step reduction from validated 180 should retain clearance margin while trimming pre-grasp time.
asi.result: One abort at 49/50; median planner 103.93 s and pre-grasp 38.06 s, not better than confirmed 180-step result.
asi.rollback_reason: Safety gate failed; automatic discard restored 180 steps.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop reducing arm-path duration. Next structural candidate should remove redundant base waypoints without changing arm dynamics.

description: Conditional pure-y l_drive detour removal; 49/50 and median planner 104.71 s, worse than validated 180-step geometry.

asi.hypothesis: Pure y legs do not need the 5 cm detour used to break pure-x screw degeneracy; removing it should save base-plan waypoints without affecting x transport.
asi.result: One abort and slower runtime; the detour also contributes needed staging clearance or timing even on pure-y calls.
asi.rollback_reason: Safety gate failed and primary runtime regressed; automatic discard restored unconditional detour.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep l_drive route unchanged. Validated frontier remains combined 180-step pan+bend geometry; avoid further waypoint deletion without per-seed safety evidence.

description: Removed redundant Stage 1 out-and-back base segment while preserving south safety corridor; 50/50 but slower than validated 180-step path.

asi.hypothesis: Starting first Stage 1 l-drive at south_line+5 cm should preserve x-leg clearance and eliminate one 5 cm return/re-entry segment.
asi.result: 50/50 preserved, but median planner 105.68 s and pre-grasp 41.64 s exceeded validated 101.07/37.90 s; no speed gain.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed despite unchanged success; automatic discard restored original Stage 1 waypoint.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not remove Stage 1 waypoints. Keep validated combined pan+bend path and original safety route.

description: Tested 80° pan with 170-step combined path; 50/50 preserved, but median planner 109.16 s regressed versus validated 101.07 s.

asi.hypothesis: Extra shoulder-pan margin should make a shorter 170-step path as stable as 180 steps while keeping joint speed comparable.
asi.result: Success intact, but runtime worse; pan angle change likely increases base correction/IK work enough to erase 10-step saving.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed by 8.0%; automatic discard restored 85°/180-step geometry.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep validated 85° pan and 180-step combined path; no more arm-speed tuning. Focus on a different geometry contract only if it has measured path reduction.

description: Reduced south staging margin 0.40→0.30 m; success fell to 48/50 and median planner rose to 107.80 s.

asi.hypothesis: The arm's high TCP should still clear the cup with a 30 cm south corridor, reducing Stage 1/2 base travel.
asi.result: Two aborts show 40 cm margin is load-bearing for collision-free staging; no speed gain.
asi.rollback_reason: Safety gate failed and runtime regressed; automatic discard restored 0.40 m corridor.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep validated corridor and 180-step arm path. Avoid further clearance reductions; seek speed in already collision-free geometry.

description: Fresh 50/10 confirmation of unchanged validated geometry: 50/50, but median runtime 115.18 s was above best 101.07 s; no code change retained.

asi.hypothesis: After multiple rejected shortcuts, repeat accepted 85°/180-step geometry to check that 50/50 reliability is not a lucky batch.
asi.result: 50/50 confirmed again. Runtime was noisy/slower than best, so no new optimization claim.
asi.rollback_reason: No code candidate and primary runtime did not beat best; discard records confirmation without changing planner.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep 85°/180-step combined path. Treat 101.07 s as best observed and require a real geometry win before replacing it.

description: Relaxed Stage 0 base alignment tolerance 4°→8°; 50/50 preserved but median planner 103.57 s exceeded best 101.07 s.

asi.hypothesis: Fixed-arm world-coordinate transport does not need exact east heading; stopping within 8° should remove variable rotation steps from Stage 0.
asi.result: No runtime win; remaining yaw error likely adds downstream correction/IK work that cancels saved rotation.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime did not improve; automatic discard restored 4° alignment.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep exact base alignment and validated 180-step arm path. Avoid trading heading margin for small step savings.

description: Lowered Stage 2 grasp torso target by 3 cm; 50/50 preserved but median planner 108.93 s exceeded validated 101.07 s.

asi.hypothesis: Starting TCP 3 cm closer to the cup should shorten Stage 3 grasp geometry and reduce pre-grasp time.
asi.result: No speed gain; lower torso target likely adds contact/IK correction cost that offsets the shorter final reach.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed; automatic discard restored TORSO_GRASP target.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep validated torso height, 85° pan, 180-step combined path. Avoid further grasp-height reductions without a stronger geometric clearance argument.

description: Fixed torso in fixed-arm base screws; 50/50 preserved but median planner 103.34 s exceeded validated 101.07 s.

asi.hypothesis: Horizontal TCP translation only needs base x/y/yaw; removing unnecessary torso DOF should reduce screw search and keep arm/torso geometry rigid.
asi.result: Success stayed 50/50, but runtime was 2.2% slower than best; extra torso DOF may help planner settle around fixture geometry despite no visible torso motion.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime regressed; automatic discard restored base+torso mask.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep validated 85°/180-step geometry and original screw mask. No further DOF reductions without a measured win.

description: Overlapped final torso rise with the 180-step pan+bend path; 50/50 preserved, but median planner 101.94 s was slightly slower than validated 101.07 s.

asi.hypothesis: Raising torso to 0.33 m before rotation and completing the final 0.056 m during arm motion should remove serial Stage 0 time without changing final arm geometry.
asi.result: 50/50 and pre-grasp 37.16 s held, but total median did not beat best; overlap adds dynamics that erase the saved steps.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime 0.9% worse than validated best; automatic discard restored serial 150-step torso ramp and 180-step arm path.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not overlap torso/arm further. Keep validated 85°/180-step geometry; current physical safety margin appears near frontier.

description: Fused Stage 2 torso lowering into first Stage 3 high-to-intermediate grasp screw, with low-torso fallback; 50/50 and planner median 101.07→89.67 s.

asi.hypothesis: The proven grasp screw already controls torso+arm; removing the serial 120-step Stage 2 torso ramp should shorten pre-grasp while fallback preserves old contract on inaccurate reaches.
asi.result: 50/50 preserved. Planner median improved 11.3%; pre-grasp 37.90→30.03 s; batch completed with 50 observed runs. Geometry fusion is a real speed win.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep fused high-to-intermediate path. Repeat 50/10 to confirm before testing any further geometric reduction.

description: Repeat fused Stage 2→Stage 3 geometry at 50/10: 50/50 confirmed; planner median 89.67→87.62 s, pre-grasp 30.03→29.55 s.

asi.hypothesis: Fused high-to-intermediate grasp path is repeatable and not a one-batch runtime outlier.
asi.result: Second independent 50/10 run succeeded 50/50. Median planner 87.62 s; pre-grasp 29.55 s; batch wall 591.8 s.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep fused path and safety fallback. Require any next geometry change to beat 87.62 s while preserving 50/50.

description: Replaced final 5 cm Stage 3 IK screw with vertical torso closure; median pre-grasp 29.35 s but reliability fell to 48/50.

asi.hypothesis: After reaching intermediate pose, same-orientation vertical closure should be safer and cheaper than a second IK screw; static final remains fallback.
asi.result: Two terminal failures despite lower runtime; vertical closure changed grasp contact/torso state enough to break downstream behavior.
asi.rollback_reason: Safety gate failed at 48/50; automatic discard restored second static grasp screw and 30-step fallback descent.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep fused high-to-intermediate path plus original final IK contract. Do not replace final screw with torso-only closure.

description: Reduced Stage 4 four-centimeter lift probe 40→30 steps; runtime fell to 85.09 s but safety gate dropped to 49/50.

asi.hypothesis: A 25% faster 4-cm probe should preserve the lift-coupling check while removing 10 physical steps.
asi.result: One failure despite faster median; probe timing is load-bearing for grasp stability.
asi.rollback_reason: Missed 50/50 safety gate; automatic discard restored 40-step probe.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not shorten held-cup validation ramps. Keep fused pre-grasp path and original Stage 4 probe.

description: Midpoint Stage 4 lift probe 35 steps; 50/50 preserved, but median planner 87.90 s was above validated 87.62 s.

asi.hypothesis: A midpoint between unsafe 30 and safe 40 probe steps could retain coupling while removing 5 physical steps.
asi.result: 50/50 held, but no primary runtime improvement over 40-step validated probe; gain is below noise/absent.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric did not beat best; automatic discard restored 40-step probe.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep 40-step Stage 4 probe. Do not spend more iterations bracketing this held-cup timing; target another geometry only with a measurable path reduction.

description: Added Stage 11 fail-fast when torso reaches floor; 50/50 and median planner 87.49 s, while avoiding repeated no-op lowering steps.

asi.hypothesis: Stage 11 sometimes repeats 300 steps after torso target is already at floor and cup cannot descend; breaking at floor should cut stalled tail without changing normal contact stop or evaluation.
asi.result: 50/50 preserved; 12/50 runs hit the previous 300-step ceiling, and candidate median planner was 87.49 s versus 87.62 s baseline. This is a safe tail-latency geometry guard, though median gain is small.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep floor guard. Validate broader robustness before further changes; avoid touching validated grasp and transport ramps.

description: Repeat Stage 11 floor-guard candidate: 50/50 confirmed, but median planner 89.99 s was above best 87.49 s; no code change retained.

asi.hypothesis: Floor guard should preserve reliability and tail-latency behavior across an independent 50/10 batch.
asi.result: 50/50 confirmed again. Runtime variation exceeded the tiny prior median gain; no stronger speed claim from this repeat.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary runtime did not beat best; planner remains unchanged with guard already retained.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep guard as validated tail protection. Require a meaningful geometry improvement before further edits.
